summary: Frontend mobile regression retested setup, toss, active scoring, bounds, named history, theme palette, rules sheet, and landscape layout.

integration_issues.issue: After completing a named board and reopening the public preview in a fresh browser context, the app returned to setup instead of restoring the active match.

action_items: Investigate AsyncStorage persistence and restore timing across a cold web reload/fresh context; verify carrom-match is written and read reliably.
critical_code_review_comments: Light palette styles are now applied to cards, controls, muted text, history, and rules; theme rendering visibly changed in the captured mobile screen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, setup to toss to active passed with Alice/Bob; men clamped 1..9, dues stayed nonnegative, queen + 9 produced +12 and named history. Theme screenshot visibly switched to white cards/light text palette and rules opened. Landscape overflow was not reached in the second run because the fresh context loaded setup rather than persisted active state.
rca_of_issue: The tested cold reload/fresh browser context did not restore carrom-match. index.tsx reads AsyncStorage once on mount and only writes when mode is active; verify the write completes after state transitions and that the web storage backend is available before relying on the read.
